name: Browser Use Cloud

modes.label: Browser runtime
modes.note: Plus bandwidth; proxy enabled by default. Running browser remains billable after agent run/CDP disconnect. Unspecified guest OS is not a selectable OS guarantee.

plans.name: Pay as you go
plans.note: No subscription; $5 minimum top-up; never expires. Spend-tier concurrency separate.

plans.name: Spend tier 50
plans.note: Requires $200 qualifying lifetime payments per pricing page ($100 in docs: conflict). Not a monthly $200 fee.

features.ip_note: US residential proxy on by default ($5/GB, country selectable); custom/BYO proxy on all accounts, then traffic billed $0.20/GB.

caveats: Storage, snapshot GiB-month and public IPv4 prices are not published in the reviewed sources; null is not free.

No guaranteed vCPU allocation published; browser-hour is not a verified 4-vCPU/8-GiB VM equivalent. The sizes card keeps unknown hardware null; do not coerce it to zero or auto-rank against resource-guaranteed VMs.
Browser RAM is not published unless a specific mode overrides it.
No current Dev/Business/Scaleup subscriptions offered; older comparisons are obsolete for new buyers. Legacy concurrency grants can be preserved.

Concurrency is lifetime purchased-credit spend, not monthly fee. Card cannot enforce a historical spend gate; the zero-fee higher tiers must not be auto-selected without checking account qualification.
Pricing page says $200 lifetime spend unlocks 50 sessions; docs says $100. Keep both and inspect account grant before purchasing solely for concurrency.

V 4 agent browsers have four-hour hard timeout and roughly 20-minute idle cleanup after inactive runs. An eight-hour single session is not valid for that product; standalone browser limits may differ.
No 4/8 guarantee; model prices are separate token meters, not compute. Managed token prices already include the 20% fee; do not add it twice.

Browser create API reserves the full requested runtime amount up front, refunding unused duration at stop proportionally; final billing remains rounded up to whole minutes. A prepaid wallet must cover the initial reservation.

fleet.verification: Eligible Google/GitHub/Microsoft signup gets introductory credits without card. Paid tiers use net settled lifetime Stripe payments per project; refunds, disputes and grants excluded.
fleet.tiers: 10 at $0; 50 at $200 lifetime spend on pricing page versus $100 in concurrency docs (conflict); 250 at $1,000; 500 at $5,000; 1,000 at $25,000. Custom Enterprise by contact.
fleet.notes: Browser and agent runs share project concurrency; more API keys do not add capacity. Qualifying cumulative purchases, not monthly fee or current wallet balance. Higher legacy grants preserved. Because first threshold conflicts, confirm project Billing/API limit before buying solely to raise it; no guaranteed processing time.
